bandReport.notes: p00 IS the instructions cover (T.B.C. SRSU-S-GKL, Test Booklet Series A, GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, 120 items, 100 marks, two hours) — not transcribed. The rendered pages are the ENGLISH half only: p01=printed p3, p02=p5, p03=p7, p04=p9, p05=p11, p06=p13 — i.e. odd printed pages, with Hindi on the intervening even pages (visible only as show-through ghosting). Band is Q1-32, contiguous, no gaps. Q1 is the first question of the paper and is complete on p01; Q32 ends cleanly at the foot of p06's right column with white space after it. Checked p07 (B2's territory): it opens at Q33 (left column) and Q37 (right column), so nothing of mine spills forward and nothing of B2's reaches back. Per-page counts: p01 Q1-5, p02 Q6-10, p03 Q11-16, p04 Q17-20, p05 Q21-26, p06 Q27-32. TWO-COLUMN CONTINUATION HAZARD hit twice, both resolved by crop: on p05 Q23's three statements end at the foot of the LEFT column and its 'Select the correct answer' + (a)-(d) block heads the RIGHT column (verified at 5x — the block is indented at option level, carries no question number, is a 3-statement code matching Q23, and Q24 starts below it); on p06 Q30's two statements end at the foot of the LEFT column and its 'Which of the statements given above is/are correct?' + (a)-(d) block heads the RIGHT column (verified at 6x — 2-statement code matching Q30, Q31 starts below it). In both cases the block is a column continuation, not the options of the question printed beside it. No shared Directions: code block anywhere in this band — every question carries its own four options. No Match List in this band. No figures, no maps, no diagrams. Option-order irregularities that were crop-verified because they break the usual pattern: Q5 runs (a) 1, 2 and 3 / (b) 1 and 2 only / (c) 2 and 3 only / (d) 1 only; Q10 runs (a) 1 and 4 only / (b) 1, 2, 3 and 4 / (c) 2 and 3 only / (d) 1, 2 and 3 only; Q29's (c) is '3 and 4' with no 'only' while (d) is '4 only'. Typography: the booklet sets decimal points as a raised middle dot (Q9 '3·5 lakh km', Q13 '0·5 MeV'); transcribed as ordinary '.' since it is a house style, not a defect. Bold-italic emphasis is load-bearing and preserved in Q6 (not), Q16 (cannot), Q17 (not), Q24 (no). No page defects, no torn/unprinted pages, no missing or duplicated options — every one of the 32 questions prints exactly four alternatives (a)-(d). Catalog gaps flagged on Q1 (Chalcolithic/non-Harappan protohistoric cultures), Q3 (history of science in medieval India) and Q28 (plant morphology — modified stems and roots).
